//course: The NIMAS course to watch. serialNo is the exact "Serial No" cell in the site's course table and is what we match on.
//api: The ERP backend the nimasdirang.com React app calls to fill its course table. authToken is NOT a secret: it is the site's own public constant (REACT_APP_BASE_AUTHKEY), shipped in its JS bundle to every visitor. templateID 3 = the courses table; categoryName is the server-side filter.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//dailyHour: Send one summary push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose). This is both your daily reminder and the proof-of-life heartbeat. -1 disables. If you ever stop getting it, the tracker is dead.
notify.//urgentThreshold: Below this many remaining seats we enter URGENT mode: high-priority nags until you book. 0 seats is not urgent, it is sold out.
notify.//urgentRemindMinutes: In urgent mode, re-ping at most every N minutes. 55 is deliberately just under the 60-minute check interval so every hourly check nags.

//watch: Used only in --watch mode. intervalMinutes between checks (60 = hourly, which is what urgent mode's 55-minute nag assumes); jitterSeconds randomizes timing a little so it does not look robotic.
